rows.grounds: locative of śūnya-kūpa, the empty well
fused form svārtham + avidaṃ; first-person singular aorist of vid with object svārtham

items.question: What self-knowledge did the speaker lack while wandering blindly like a frog in an empty well?
premises: speaker compares himself to frog in empty well
he never knew his own purpose
guru's guidance is praised in preceding verses
items.inference: The verse confesses ignorance of self-purpose before receiving the guru's path.
uncertainties: exact tense and voice of avidaṃ remain uncertain
sandhi fusion svārthamavidaṃ is analyzed as fused, not split into separate rows
items.plain_english: Like a frog in an empty well, I never knew my own purpose at any time.
